title: Cyber Safety Assessment
description: The Cyber Safety Assessment evaluates how securely a school manages its digital systems, data, and online activities to protect students and staff

questions.text: Are all school computers, tablets, and routers patched and updated with the latest security versions?
Ensure backup is active for all important data. Has this been verified within the last 6 months?
Is the internet filtering system (to block unsafe or inappropriate websites) working effectively and reviewed regularly?
Have there been any cyber incidents or near misses (e.g., phishing, data loss, online bullying) reported in the last 6 months?
Are email security measures (spam filter, phishing detection, suspicious link alerts) active and up to date?
Have all third-party or cloud-based applications used by staff or students been reviewed for security compliance in the past 6 months?
Has password rotation been completed in the last 6 months for Wi-Fi networks, staff accounts, and admin systems?
Were cyber safety awareness sessions conducted for students and staff during this 6-month period?
Have all software subscriptions and licenses used by the school been audited in the past 6 months, and were any unnecessary or unused tools removed?
Have user access privileges been reviewed to ensure that only authorized staff and students have access to critical systems and data?
Are all school buses and vans holding valid vehicle fitness certificates, insurance, and pollution control documents?
Have driver and attendant background verifications (police check, license validity, ID proof) been completed and documented?\n
Is a GPS tracking system installed and actively monitored on all school transport vehicles?
Are CCTV cameras and panic buttons installed and functional inside all buses and vans?
Is a female attendant present on every vehicle during student pickup and drop, as per regulatory guidelines?
Are first-aid kits and fire extinguishers available, intact, and checked for expiry in every vehicle?
Are boarding and deboarding areas within the school premises clearly marked, supervised, and safe for students?
Have driver behavior and speed limits been reviewed using GPS or manual logs to ensure compliance?
Are transport maintenance records updated, including regular servicing, brake checks, and tire condition reports?
Have transport safety drills or orientation sessions been conducted for drivers, attendants, and students on safe travel behavior and emergency actions?\n\n
Has the school appointed a Designated Child Protection Officer (CPO) and is their contact information visibly displayed for students and staff?
Have all teachers, non-teaching staff, and volunteers undergone background verification (police check and ID validation)?
Are all staff members trained and sensitized about child protection laws (e.g., POCSO Act) and safe interaction protocols?
Is there a Child Protection Policy in place, and has it been reviewed or updated in the last 6 months?
Is there a confidential reporting mechanism (e.g., complaint box, helpline, digital form) available for students to report concerns safely?
Are students educated through workshops or sessions about personal safety, boundaries, and how to report inappropriate behavior?
Are CCTV cameras functional and covering key areas such as corridors, entry/exit points, and common spaces without invading privacy zones?
Have all reported incidents or complaints (if any) been recorded, investigated promptly, and documented with outcomes?
Are school transport staff and external vendors (cleaning, maintenance, canteen) also trained and verified for child safety compliance?
Has the Internal Child Protection Committee conducted a review meeting in the last 6 months, and were action points recorded and followed up?
Are all restrooms cleaned, disinfected, and maintained regularly with proper cleaning schedules displayed?
Is safe drinking water available throughout the school, and are water quality tests conducted and documented?
Are waste segregation practices (wet/dry waste) followed and bins properly labeled and covered?
Has the school conducted pest control treatments within the last 6 months and maintained vendor/service records?
Are handwashing facilities available, functional, and supplied with soap or sanitizer in all key areas (restrooms, cafeteria, labs)?
Is the school cafeteria or kitchen meeting hygiene standards ,  clean preparation area, proper food storage, and staff wearing protective gear? Share your observations in comments, if any non hygiene
Are medical facilities or first-aid rooms available, equipped with essential medicines, and managed by a trained nurse or first-aid responder?
Are health checkups or wellness programs conducted for students and staff at least once in 6 months?
Are waste disposal partners or municipal cleaning services verified for safe collection and disposal of waste?
Are cleaning staff trained and provided with protective gear (gloves, masks, aprons) and supervised during sanitation activities?
Are there any damaged or leaning trees within or near the school premises that could pose a risk of falling during storms or heavy winds?
Have all open pits, drains, or manholes been identified and securely covered to prevent accidental falls?
Are all electrical wires, panels, and outdoor cables properly insulated, secured, and free from water exposure or damage?
Are school boundary walls and fences structurally sound, with no cracks, loose bricks, or leaning sections?
Are construction or maintenance areas, if any, clearly barricaded and marked with warning signs?
Are pathways, playgrounds, and outdoor spaces free of uneven surfaces, potholes, or slippery zones?
Has the rainwater drainage system been cleaned and maintained to prevent waterlogging and mosquito breeding?
Are chemical storage and cleaning supplies kept in safe, ventilated areas away from children's reach?
Are outdoor lighting systems functional and sufficient for visibility during early morning or late evening school hours?
Has a campus-level environmental risk walk-through inspection been conducted in the last 6 months, and were identified issues resolved?

title: Vehicle Check Assessment
description: This assessment ensures all key safety and operational features of school vehicles are checked weekly.

questions.text: Are all exterior lights (headlights, brake lights, indicators) functioning properly?
Are the brakes in good working condition?
Are tyres properly inflated and free of excess wear/damage?
Is the horn operational?
Are mirrors and windows clean and without cracks or damage?
Is the windscreen wiper system working, and washer fluid filled?
Are emergency exits accessible and clearly marked?
Is a first-aid kit available and fully stocked?
Is a functional fire extinguisher present and accessible?
Are the seat belts (if fitted) present and functional?
Is the floor clean, free of debris, and not slippery?
Are all seats and handrails securely fixed and in good condition?
Are there any visible fuel or fluid leaks?
Is the vehicle free from any unusual noises or vibrations during a short test run?
Are safety instructions (emergency contacts, procedures) displayed inside the vehicle?
Is school signage/board displayed prominently?
Are all CCTV cameras functional in classrooms, corridors, and entry/exit areas, and has the footage retention been verified?
Have all restricted or hazardous areas (e.g., electrical rooms, labs, rooftops, maintenance zones) been securely locked and access-controlled?
Are first-aid kits available in every block and updated with non-expired medical supplies?
Have emergency exits and stairways been inspected to ensure they are clear, well-marked, and unobstructed?
Is there adequate lighting and visibility in corridors, restrooms, and outdoor play areas during all school hours?
Are supervision protocols in place during recess, physical education, and sports periods to prevent accidents or bullying?
Have all playground and sports equipment been checked for damage, sharp edges, or instability?
Are CCTV and security monitoring staff logs reviewed periodically to confirm proper observation and response readiness?
Have incident reports related to student safety (if any) been reviewed and preventive actions taken within the last 6 months?
Have awareness drills or safety orientation sessions been conducted for students and staff on physical safety practices (e.g., emergency behavior, safe movement, avoiding restricted zones)?
Are emergency contact numbers (fire, police, ambulance, hospital) displayed prominently across key areas in the school?
Have evacuation drills or mock emergency drills been conducted in the last 6 months, and are records maintained?
Are emergency exits, alarm systems, and assembly points clearly marked, accessible, and communicated to students and staff?
Is the school medical room or first-aid center adequately stocked, and is a trained medical responder available during school hours?
Are communication systems (PA system, intercom, or digital alerts) functional and tested periodically for emergency use?
Have teachers and staff received training on how to guide students safely during emergencies and follow evacuation protocols?
Has the school established a coordination plan with local authorities (police, fire, hospitals) for quick response in case of a crisis?
Have all emergency related incidents, near misses, or emergency drills been reviewed, and has the ERT implemented corrective actions for improvement?
Has an Emergency Response Team (ERT) been formed with clearly assigned roles and responsibilities for staff members?
Has the school developed and maintained a Crisis Management Plan covering natural disasters, fire, medical, and security emergencies?
